AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#353 @ e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/3/3

Job: AUD-SOL-L12-117; agent 117; independent T4 money/auth-state audit.

### B-353-1 — Retired and out-of-order status reads still mutate the live lockout

`src/entitlements/dunning/DunningLockoutProvider.tsx:80-116,157-175`. `refresh` writes both React state and the process-global signal after its await without checking provider lifetime, account/auth generation or request ordering; cleanup only removes the subscription. Unmounting the old account's children through the persisted-cache identity gate therefore does not retire its dunning request. ([Exact provider](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/DunningLockoutProvider.tsx#L80-L116), [actual identity gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/services/PersistedQueryCacheGate.tsx))

**Two mounted CI counterexamples:** (1) A starts its status request, A's provider unmounts, B's provider completes a clear read, then A's old locked response arrives: B displays the lockout; B's next offline refresh cannot remove it; (2) an older clear read is pending, a newer locked read completes, then the old clear answer arrives: the live overlay disappears and the singleton clears. Both fail actual UI/store assertions in the independent probe; no malformed-body or server authorization bypass is needed. The backend still enforces access, but the client denies a paid next account or exposes contradictory paused/access UI. ([Final lifecycle CI proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179882612))

**Minimal fix rule:** fence every post-await status/error/global-write/cancel-result continuation against the owning provider/account/auth generation; retire on cleanup and account transition; additionally sequence/coalesce reads so an older completion cannot overwrite newer authority. Keep malformed-response last-state preservation, foreground refresh and paid-query invalidation. Regress both completion orders, unmount/A→B, disable, and delayed cancel completion; do not rely solely on clearing the singleton, since an old provider can repopulate it. L1's separate stale-403 finding is not counted again here. ([Provider cancel boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/DunningLockoutProvider.tsx#L157-L175), [L1 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5976926738))

### B-353-2 — A retired UpdateCard screen can start new native/payment work

`src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx:134-177,182-245,263-284`. The mounted screen's quote/start/resume/settle/cancel continuations have no lifetime or account fence, and the native helper has no cancellation/ownership port. Its Back action remains available during the pre-sheet quote. ([Exact screen](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx#L182-L245), [Back](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx#L258-L260), [helper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/updateCard.ts))

**Two mounted CI counterexamples:** (1) press Add a card, hold the quote, unmount the screen, release the quote: the retired action still posts setup, opens the native sheet and posts confirm with the 15,000-cent approval; (2) hold a native presentation return, unmount, then return success: a new confirm/pay request still launches. Both now fail concrete call assertions, not timeouts. During an auth turnover each subsequent API call reads the current token, so retaining old closures/approval while opening fresh native work is not an account-owned operation. Existing backend ownership checks are not being claimed bypassed. ([Final proof, six actual negative assertions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179882612), [request-time auth selection](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/services/api.ts#L105-L128))

**Minimal fix rule:** bind the operation to the initiating account/auth generation, retire screen-owned work on unmount/leave, check before any later setup/native presentation/pay/resume/navigation/alert/state write, and pass the ownership/cancellation predicate through the native flow's awaits. Preserve already-sent money-operation identity for truthful account-bound reconciliation; stopping a client continuation cannot prove a server request was canceled or that nothing charged. Add real deferred-quote/native-return unmount and A→B tests alongside positive same-account payment/bank-retry controls; do not remove multi-invoice, bank recovery or 1A pay-on-save functionality. ([Affected flow](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx), [native flow owned by L1](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352))

### B-353-3 — Dispute lockout is shown as a decline that a card update will repair

`src/entitlements/dunning/DunningLockoutScreen.tsx:37-43,120-139`; `DunningBanner.tsx:9-18`; `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:75-89,300-301,331-364`. The API already exposes `status.kind === 'dispute'` and `quote.disputes`, but these money/recovery surfaces ignore them: they call the card declined, promise immediate charging/restoration, and a dispute-only Save card result offers Done without explaining the still-paused access. ([Lockout UI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/DunningLockoutScreen.tsx#L120-L139), [card UI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx), [retained dispute contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/dunningApi.ts))

**Contract and mounted proof:** paired backend D5 `e0afe6780e5954b20e88cfaefd63f12cd31d218d` distinguishes reversal status, includes dispute-only quotes with no payable invoice, deliberately keeps dispute access unchanged, and appends “Saving a card does not settle that; contact support” to its result. The client builds its own local outcome body instead. Both disputed-lockout and dispute-only-card-save UI probes fail their recovery-truth assertions; ordinary locked UI and a mounted paid flow controls pass. ([Backend status](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e0afe6780e5954b20e88cfaefd63f12cd31d218d/src/checkout/dunning-v2/dunning-v2.service.ts), [backend quote/access/result composition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e0afe6780e5954b20e88cfaefd63f12cd31d218d/src/checkout/client-billing.service.ts), [mounted negative proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179882612))

**Minimal fix rule:** use the existing status kind and retained quote dispute identities to explain the reversed payment and provide the working support/coach/cancel paths; a card update may still save a card/pay ordinary invoices, but must never promise it settles the dispute or restores that plan. Preserve mixed payment-plus-dispute behavior and confirmed per-currency receipts; use explicit structured result dispute metadata if needed rather than discarding the limitation. Test dispute-only before/after save and mixed paid/disputed plans. This is a mobile presentation finding, not a requested backend behavior change. ([Existing backend semantics](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e0afe6780e5954b20e88cfaefd63f12cd31d218d/src/checkout/client-billing.service.ts), [affected client](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353))

### C — optional / carried

- **C-353-1 (carried C-322-4):** `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:117-124,159-174,227-245` keeps the bank action/approval solely in component state/ref. The L3 test labelled “after a remount” supplies the helper's context manually, not a mounted-screen restoration. Add an account-bound non-secret recovery locator and a real lifecycle test if restart continuity is required; do not call the helper test a device/remount pass. This does not itself prove a new false-charge claim. ([Prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392), [actual screen state](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx#L117-L124))
- **C-353-2 (carried C-322-3, operator composition):** `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:237-244,296-303`; whichever stack/#334 merges second must keep the native UpdateCard path and resolve the past-due-banner overlap without restoring a hosted billing portal. ([Prior carried item](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392), [current native path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx#L237-L244))
- **C-353-3:** `DunningLockoutScreen.tsx:138`; `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:461`: JSX still contains “We charge” / “our payment provider”; the L3 quoted-string guard does not inspect JSX text. Remove these first-person phrases and extend the guard to rendered JSX; this is a cheap copy cleanup, not a money/auth blocker by itself. The lockout's initial End plan alert at `:87-88` should also retain the paid-before-cancel caveat already present in UpdateCard's conditional confirmation rather than always promising today. ([Lockout copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/DunningLockoutScreen.tsx), [UpdateCard copy/conditional alert](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e22acc84b3ee99c94f3ec77793b38ca0c8157241/src/entitlements/dunning/UpdateCardScreen.tsx), [L3 guard](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/37ed3d56c3ed1173f7da8791408e4887de3898bf/src/entitlements/dunning/__tests__/nativeCardUpdate.test.tsx))

### Evidence reuse, CI and landing limits

The complete L2 diff and navigation/auth/support consumers were independently read. G09 reuses only this model's [#322 approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392) on byte-identical files: B-322-1/2/3/4/5/6/7 and C-322-2 closures remain on their proven scope; the newly proved lifecycle/dispute cases were not covered by that evidence. The stack top equals the automatic original-plus-main merge tree `8f0a27302988e47a0b375c29465b3b9ad7b7dd01`; only `app.json` incorporates already-landed main OTA/build hunks. No L2 source imports L3; L3 carries the native-flow suite, so land the complete stack as instructed. ([Original approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392), [split stack/top](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/354), [operator landing rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5975773732))

Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test is SUCCESS and executed lint/typecheck/tests; both required analyses are **absent at this stacked-base head**, not silently counted green. The combined main-target candidate must run every required context before landing. Independent final probe CI: **6 failed / 39 passed**, comprising the six concrete findings above plus positive controls and the passing existing lockout suite. The first probe run had two audit-harness timeouts from awaiting RTL's deferred async press; that harness was corrected without changing production source, and the final run proves those cases by actual setup/confirm calls instead. No local heavy command, PR-branch push, production/flag/settings action or paid build occurred. ([Executed candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37153881234/job/111293149084), [final assertion proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179882612), [superseded harness run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179751596))

Default: close these three Bs and L1's B, preserve functionality, restack/test, then obtain both exact-head lens verdicts; backend #687–#691 must be approved/landed/deployed first. Keep FEATURE_DUNNING_V2 activation and real-device PaymentSheet/3DS/redirect/universal-link acceptance as separate authorized release gates. Probe patches, logs, snapshots and both verdicts are retained in `ops/aud-117/AUD-SOL-L12-117/`. ([L1 finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/352#issuecomment-5976926738), [landing dependency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/353#issuecomment-5975773732), [prior release limits](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5964847392))
